tools.name: spectora_list_inspections
tools.description: List inspections for your company, with filters for date range, status, inspector, service and location. Canceled, deleted and archived inspections are excluded unless you ask for them. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspections.

tools.name: spectora_get_inspection
tools.description: Get one inspection by id, optionally with related records (buyer, property, custom fields). Spectora API: GET /v2/inspections/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_list_inspection_attachments
tools.description: List files attached to inspections (for example, reports). Filter by inspection id. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspection_attachments.

tools.name: spectora_list_availabilities
tools.description: Find open inspector time slots for a date range of up to one month, for the services you want to book. Use it before creating an inspection to offer a real time. Slots ignore service areas and lead time. Spectora API: GET /v2/availabilities.

tools.name: spectora_list_contacts
tools.description: List clients (Spectora calls them contacts) for your company. Filter by full-text search, tag or buyer id. Spectora API: GET /v2/contacts.

tools.name: spectora_get_contact
tools.description: Get one client (contact) by id. Spectora API: GET /v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_create_contact
tools.description: Create a client (contact) in your company. Creates a new record each time, so check spectora_list_contacts first. Spectora API: POST /v2/contacts.

tools.name: spectora_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields of one client (contact). Only the fields you send change. The email cannot be changed here. Spectora API: PUT /v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_list_agents
tools.description: List real estate agents (Spectora calls them connections) that refer your inspections. Filter by full-text search, email, agency or tag. Spectora API: GET /v2/connections.

tools.name: spectora_get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent (connection) by connection id. Spectora API: GET /v2/connections/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_get_agent_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated referral and inspection statistics per agent, for scorecards and referral tracking. Spectora API: GET /v2/connection_stats.

tools.name: spectora_list_inspectors
tools.description: List the inspectors on your staff, with an active filter. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspectors.

tools.name: spectora_get_inspector
tools.description: Get one inspector by id. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspectors/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_list_services
tools.description: List the services your company offers for inspections. Spectora API: GET /v2/services.

tools.name: spectora_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events for your company. Filter by inspection, inspector, event type or start date range. Spectora API: GET /v2/events.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spectora_create_contact, spectora_list_agents · Private data: spectora_get_inspection, spectora_list_inspection_attachments, spectora_list_contacts, spectora_get_contact, spectora_create_contact, spectora_update_contact · Public sink: spectora_create_contact, spectora_update_contact, spectora_list_agents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spectora_create_contact, spectora_list_agents · Private data: spectora_get_inspection, spectora_list_inspection_attachments, spectora_list_contacts, spectora_get_contact, spectora_create_contact, spectora_update_contact · Public sink: spectora_create_contact, spectora_update_contact, spectora_list_agents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
